name: Craftmaster
body:
Your religious training, and the blessings of your god, increases your crafting abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, Artifice, Construct or Toil Domain

Benefit(s): In addition to your Intelligence modifier, you may add your Wisdom modifier to any Craft skill checks.
